text:
Alex Dev: quick q — I opened PR #4521 that renames a couple directories and updates CODEOWNERS so files under `services/runtime/*` are owned by eng-runtime. Who can actually approve that?
Maya (Eng-Platform): if it's only moving paths and updating CODEOWNERS, eng-platform should be fine, but eng-runtime owning the new paths makes sense. did you add them as owners in the file?
Alex Dev: yep added `team-eng-runtime @eng-runtime` and left `eng-platform` for infra configs. main concern is process: do we need a separate cross-team approval or is a single owner ok?
Zach SRE: for infra/ops-impacting files we usually require one approver from owners + an eng-platform reviewer. if runtime changes touch deploy manifests, include eng-sre. Is PR touching k8s ymls?
Alex Dev: just path/ownership and a tiny rename in k8s labels (no pod spec changes).
Irene (DS): from model infra side, nothing to block. but when ownership moves, please ensure oncall rota is updated if alerts reference the old path.
Maya (Eng-Platform): recommendation: get one ack from eng-runtime (they're listed as owners), then ping eng-platform for a quick LGTM for repo-level hygiene. I'll review today.
Alex Dev: ok I'll @eng-runtime and add a small note in PR about the oncall/alerts change. thanks.
codeowners-bot: NOTE: Changing CODEOWNERS requires at least one current owner to approve according to repo policy. See https://go/repo-codeowners.
Alex Dev: hmm, I didn't get an owner review yet. @Maya any chance you can act as the repo owner for this change so we can merge this afternoon if eng-runtime approves?
Maya (Eng-Platform): I can approve repo-hygiene changes but won't approve runtime behavior changes. since you said no spec changes, I'm OK approving the CODEOWNERS portion once eng-runtime gives a thumbs.
Alex Dev: thanks — pinging @eng-runtime: could someone review/ack the ownership handoff? tiny rename + CODEOWNERS update, no runtime logic changed.
Zach SRE: FYI, if the change touches paths referenced by monitoring, please add a short note in the deploy checklist so oncall isn't surprised.
Alex Dev: will do, added checklist item in PR description.
Irene (DS): also create a short PR comment listing any dashboards or alerts to update. prevents follow-ups after merge.
Alex Dev: done. tagging back once eng-runtime approves. :thumbsup:
Maya (Eng-Platform): thx. if you don't hear by EOD, ping me and I'll help escalate to eng-runtime lead.
